name: Difference triangle set (7,5)
description: Choose 7 rows of 6 increasing integers starting at 0 so that all differences between two entries of the same row are distinct over all rows, with the largest entry as small as possible. The best known set has largest entry 112 (Shehadeh, Kingsford and Kschischang, 2025); the simple counting bound is 105.

sources.locator: Shehadeh, Kingsford and Kschischang, J. Combin. Des. 34(1) (2026) 37-50 (CC BY 4.0; arXiv:2502.19517), Table I: m(7,5) <= 112, previous best 113; only the (14,4) and (15,4) sets are claimed optimal.
The (7,5) set of scope 112 found by the FPGA search (MIT).
Klove (1989), Bounds and construction for difference triangle sets: the problem, its use for convolutional self-orthogonal codes and lower bounds.

requirements.datasets: None; the instance is defined by the parameters and no file is read at evaluation time.

evaluation.paper_metric: Local protocol; see candidate contract and source adaptation notes

execution.interface: construct(n_rows, k) -> list of n_rows rows; the evaluator passes this task's n_rows and k. Each row is a list of k + 1 integers that starts at 0 and increases strictly. Valid when all positive differences a_j - a_i (i < j) inside the rows are distinct over all rows. Score: the scope, the largest entry, minimized; it is an upper bound on m(n_rows, k).

limitations: Differs from the catalog's Sidon-set tasks: those ask for one or two Sidon sets in a fixed interval, whereas this asks for 7 rulers with jointly distinct differences and minimizes the largest mark.
Only the counting bound n k (k+1) / 2 = 105 is reported by the evaluator; stronger linear-programming lower bounds exist in the literature.

The record construction is public, so a candidate can reproduce the record by embedding it; the score measures the returned object, not the search that produced it, and only a strictly smaller score than the best known value is a new result.
Candidate Python runs inside the evaluator process as trusted research code; the evaluator recomputes every property of the returned object exactly and trusts nothing the candidate reports.

state_of_the_art.statement: The best known (7,5) difference triangle set has scope 112, found by a search implemented in FPGA hardware (Shehadeh, Kingsford and Kschischang, 2025); the previous best was 113. Optimality is not claimed for it; the counting bound is 105.

science_relevance.scientific_problem: Determine m(7,5), the least scope of a difference triangle set with 7 rows of 6 marks whose within-row differences are all distinct.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Difference triangle sets yield convolutional self-orthogonal codes for threshold decoding and are used in radar and communication waveform design and in higher-order staircase codes; their minimal scopes are known only for small parameters, and a smaller scope gives shorter code memory and lower decoding complexity.
